text: Which lawyers in Canberra are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

result.keyword: Which lawyers in Canberra are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?
result.markdown:
Yes. I searched specifically for **Canberra lawyers with TPD (Total & Permanent Disability), superannuation and insurance-claim expertise**, rather than simply general personal-injury lawyers.

### My Canberra shortlist

| Firm | Why I’d consider them | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Law Partners Injury Lawyers Canberra** | Strong specialist TPD practice. Their Canberra partner **Lydia Wheatley** is a Personal Injury Law Accredited Specialist and leads their national Superannuation & TPD team. They explicitly handle TPD claims and offer no-win-no-fee. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/our-team/lydia-wheatley?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **My first choice for a straightforward TPD/super claim** |
| **ACT Law Associates** | Very focused on TPD claims in Canberra. They say their lawyers specialise in TPD/superannuation disputes and can take matters through insurer review, AFCA and court proceedings. [actlawassociates.com.au](https://actlawassociates.com.au/services/total-permanent-disability?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Good local specialist, particularly if a claim is disputed** |
| **LHD Lawyers Canberra** | Dedicated TPD & superannuation claims practice, with named Canberra lawyers and a free claim check. They handle declined/delayed claims as well as initial claims. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/act/canberra/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Good option for TPD + broader super issues** |
| **Monaco Solicitors** | Particularly strong TPD focus: their Canberra team says its lawyers specialise exclusively in TPD claims, with **Daniella Dababneh** specifically practising in superannuation, TPD and life insurance. They report 26 years' experience and a Canberra office. [monacosolicitors.com.au](https://monacosolicitors.com.au/service/tpd-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Excellent option if you want a highly TPD-focused firm** |
| **United Legal** | Canberra-based and specifically advertises TPD/Superannuation, including physical and mental illness claims. Its business listing also categorises it as an insurance attorney. [www.unitedlegal.com.au](https://www.unitedlegal.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Good local alternative** |
| **Slater and Gordon Lawyers Canberra** | Large national firm with a Canberra office. Its Canberra team can access specialist lawyers dealing with superannuation and disability insurance, while the national practice specifically handles TPD claims. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Good if you prefer a large national firm** |


### My top 3

If it were **my claim**, I'd speak to these three before choosing:

**1. Law Partners** — probably the strongest combination of a dedicated TPD practice, an accredited specialist leading the practice, and a physical Canberra office. Lydia Wheatley is specifically identified as the national Superannuation/TPD practice-group leader and has 20+ years in plaintiff personal injury law. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/our-team/lydia-wheatley?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Monaco Solicitors** — particularly attractive if the matter is heavily focused on TPD/superannuation rather than general personal injury. Their Canberra TPD lawyers say they work exclusively on TPD claims, and their team includes lawyers specialising in superannuation, TPD and life insurance. [monacosolicitors.com.au](https://monacosolicitors.com.au/service/tpd-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. ACT Law Associates** — worth getting a quote/opinion from because their Canberra practice is very specifically marketed around TPD and superannuation disputes, including AFCA and litigation. [actlawassociates.com.au](https://actlawassociates.com.au/services/total-permanent-disability?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### One important distinction

If **your claim has already been rejected**, I would put more weight on a lawyer's experience with **AFCA, insurer disputes and litigation** than on Google reviews or advertised "success rates." A lawyer who is excellent at lodging an uncomplicated TPD claim isn't necessarily the best choice for challenging an insurer's interpretation of the policy.

Also, don't assume you have only one TPD policy. It can be worth checking **old and current super funds**, because multiple funds can potentially contain separate insurance cover.

[Law Partners — TPD & superannuation claims](https://lawpartners.com.au/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Monaco Solicitors — Canberra TPD lawyers](https://monacosolicitors.com.au/service/tpd-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[ACT Law Associates — Canberra TPD lawyers](https://actlawassociates.com.au/services/total-permanent-disability?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[LHD Lawyers — Canberra TPD & superannuation](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/act/canberra/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **whether your TPD claim is (a) not yet lodged, (b) currently being assessed, (c) rejected, or (d) in an AFCA/court dispute**, I can narrow this to the **best 2–3 Canberra lawyers for your particular situation**, including their fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements and relevant experience.

items.markdown:
### My top 3

If it were **my claim**, I'd speak to these three before choosing:

**1. Law Partners** — probably the strongest combination of a dedicated TPD practice, an accredited specialist leading the practice, and a physical Canberra office. Lydia Wheatley is specifically identified as the national Superannuation/TPD practice-group leader and has 20+ years in plaintiff personal injury law. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/our-team/lydia-wheatley?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Monaco Solicitors** — particularly attractive if the matter is heavily focused on TPD/superannuation rather than general personal injury. Their Canberra TPD lawyers say they work exclusively on TPD claims, and their team includes lawyers specialising in superannuation, TPD and life insurance. [monacosolicitors.com.au](https://monacosolicitors.com.au/service/tpd-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. ACT Law Associates** — worth getting a quote/opinion from because their Canberra practice is very specifically marketed around TPD and superannuation disputes, including AFCA and litigation. [actlawassociates.com.au](https://actlawassociates.com.au/services/total-permanent-disability?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### One important distinction

If **your claim has already been rejected**, I would put more weight on a lawyer's experience with **AFCA, insurer disputes and litigation** than on Google reviews or advertised "success rates." A lawyer who is excellent at lodging an uncomplicated TPD claim isn't necessarily the best choice for challenging an insurer's interpretation of the policy.

Also, don't assume you have only one TPD policy. It can be worth checking **old and current super funds**, because multiple funds can potentially contain separate insurance cover.
